title: themeda forskalii subvar. hispida
intro: Themeda forskalii subvar. hispida, commonly known as the Korean grass or Korean bush grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include relieving pain, reducing fever, and soothing digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Themeda forskalii subvar. hispida include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
